== Biography ==
'''Margaret Glasgow''' was baptised at Glasgow High Kirk on 6 May 1610 as the lawful daughter of [[Glasgow-1099|George Glasgow]] and [[Stewart-65226|Margaret Steuart]]. The witnesses were John Bornes and David Scheirar.<ref>Scotland's People, Glasgow High Kirk baptisms 1609–1777, entry for Margaret Glasgow, 6 May 1610, reference 1/233.</ref>

Her father is independently identified in the burgess admission of her husband, [[Stewart-62608|James Stewart]]. On 18 July 1633 James, a merchant, was admitted burgess and guild brother by right of his marriage to Margaret, lawful daughter of George Glasgow, merchant, burgess and guild brother.<ref>James R. Anderson, ed., ''Burgesses & Guild Brethren of Glasgow, 1573-1750'' (Edinburgh: Scottish Record Society, 1925), p. 86, [https://archive.org/details/scottishrecordso43scotuoft/page/n100/mode/2up entry for James Stewart, 18 July 1633].</ref>

Margaret married James Stewart in Glasgow in 1632. The exact calendar date remains unresolved as described below.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1099]] is assessed at 99% (proved). Margaret’s 6 May 1610 Glasgow High Kirk entry names George Glasgow and Margaret Steuart, with John Bornes and David Scheirar as witnesses. The full couple matches the selected George’s established family.

Confident for the recorded daughter; witness names do not alone establish additional kin.

Next useful test: Use the original OPR 1/233 entry if a reading conflict appears.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1100 Scotland's People, Glasgow High Kirk baptisms 1609–1777, entry for Margaret Glasgow, 6 May 1610, reference 1/233.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



=== Marriage-date conflict ===
The structured marriage field currently gives '''7 April 1632''', while the cited OPR transcription in the earlier biography gave '''4 July 1632''' under reference 644/1 230/109. These appear to be transposed day and month values. The original OPR entry has not been checked for this update, so neither value has been silently preferred; the structured date is preserved pending inspection of the original.

=== Possible match in a 1636 Kilwinning testament index ===
The printed Glasgow testament index records “Margaret, in Byris of Kilwinning” on 8 November 1636.<ref>Francis J. Grant, ed., ''The Commissariot Record of Glasgow: Register of Testaments, 1547–1800'' (Edinburgh: Scottish Record Society, 1901), p. 196, s.v. Glasgow, entry for “Margaret, in Byris of Kilwinning,” 8 Nov. 1636; FamilySearch, item #007960708, image 112/300, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS8K-D98V?view=fullText&keywords=Glasgow&searchForm=advanced&lang=en&groupId=M97N-2NT image]. The independent scan is [https://www.electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso07scotuoft.pdf#page=206 p. 196].</ref>

This may be this profile, since her age and chronology fit, but the index gives no spouse, kin, occupation, or link to Byris. The date is the index entry date, not a proved death date. The identification is unresolved pending the underlying testament; no structured date or place is inferred from this index.
